profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company, ticker AUR, headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Its site describes it as delivering self-driving freight powered by the Aurora Driver, which the company says combines cutting-edge hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and integrates autonomy into a customer's fleet. Aurora describes its aim as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site carries quotes from partners rather than product detail. One partner describes a pilot program that autonomously hauled freight between Fort Worth and El Paso and a hybrid model pairing professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. Another says the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous, and cites a projection that freight volumes will grow five fold between 2010 and 2050. A further quote says the Aurora Driver is designed to perform like the best drivers holding CDLs.

Company records list it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001828108 and headquarters in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Its litigation record shows 117 cases in Pennsylvania.
